name: kiosk
description: Self-service photobooth kiosk (Windows): QR Ph payment, capture, print and QR download.
author: Photobooth Software

scripts.build: cross-env VITE_FAKE_API= VITE_TRIAL= electron-vite build && node scripts/check-prod-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:trial: cross-env VITE_TRIAL=1 VITE_FAKE_API= VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= VITE_WEB_BASE_URL= electron-vite build && node scripts/check-prod-bundle.mjs out-trial --trial && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.trial.yml
scripts.build:e2e: cross-env VITE_FAKE_API=1 VITE_TRIAL= VITE_WEB_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron-vite build
